Genetic researcher |family =[[Cassandra Hawthorne]] - wife {{Icon|dead}} |TV actor =[[Eric Berryman]] }} {{Quotation|I want to reiterate that a society governed by scientists really is the ideal social structure!}} '''Lloyd Hawthorne''' was a leader of [[Hawthorne Medical Laboratories]], as well as the first [[overseer]] of [[Vault 4]] in the [[Fallout (TV series)|''Fallout'' TV series]]. ==Background== He was a [[Vault-Tec Corporation|Vault-Tec]] scientist, later overseer, specializing in the effects of radiation on human DNA. He, his family, and eighty volunteers participated in a five-year-long trial run of Vault 4 before the [[Great War]]. After the war, he and his wife [[Cassandra Hawthorne|Cassandra]] took shelter in Vault 4, where he served as Overseer of the Vault and conducted cruel human experiments, including hybridizing humans with radiation-resistant animals and creating [[Gulper (TV series)|gulpers]]. At least several years after the Vault was sealed, the test subjects of Vault 4 revolted against the Vault scientists, which led to his death. ==''Fallout'' TV series== ===[[The Trap]]=== [[File:The Trap Cooper at wrap party.png|thumb|right|250px|Bud and the Hawthornes attend the wrap party]] Before the war, Hawthorne and his family appeared in a Vault-Tec commercial alongside [[The Ghoul|Cooper Howard]] where he and his wife explained that they would be staying in the vault for a five-year trial period of the vault before the war. He and his wife also attended the wrap party at Cooper Howard's home alongside [[Bud Askins]]. ===[[The Radio]]=== In 2296, [[Lucy MacLean|Lucy]] was shown a holotape recording of Overseer Hawthorne's death alongside his wife in a room barricaded against a gulper that the revolting test subjects that Hawthorne and the Vault 4 scientists had been experimenting on released. In his final moments, he was unapologetic, insisting that, despite the failure of Vault 4's experiment, a society governed by scientists is "the ideal social structure" and that hybridizing humans with animals "still has potential" before a gulper killed him that the residents unleashed. ==Appearances== Lloyd Hawthorne appears only {{in|FOTV}}. {{FOTV appearances|6=106|7=107}} ==Gallery== S1E6 Character 20.jpg|Lloyd and Cassandra filming a Vault 4 advertisement Fallout Season 1 Amazon Vault-Tec.png|Lloyd and Cassandra filming a Vault 4 advertisement with Cooper Howard Hawthorne Final Words.png|Hawthorne just before his death {{Navbox characters FOTV}} {{Navbox overseers}} [[Category:Fallout TV series human characters]] [[Category:Overseers]] [[Category:Vault 4 characters]] [[ru:Ллойд Хоторн]]
